simulated: This is a simulated unseen fault inside one dataset (MAFAULDA) from one test rig: a model trained without one fault class is shown recordings of that class. It is not evidence that the system recognises genuinely novel real-world faults.
further_inspection: "Further inspection needed" means the proposed familiar label was not accepted. It does not identify the hidden fault, and it is not a claim that a new fault type has been discovered.
easier_part: The eligible examples exclude the largest severities and the fastest shaft speeds, because those partitions are reserved and sealed. This page therefore shows the easier part of the unfamiliar-fault problem, not the hardest part.
gates_note: The AE-6 and B1s healthy-baseline checks are shown only as a possible caution; under the default rule (B_with_caution) they do not decide the verdict.
scoring_path: ml.final.score_cnn on the CPU; shared Mahalanobis; verdict ml.arbitrator.decide (B_with_caution)
